grid.viewport: Design first for 1366x768: 100vw x 100dvh app shell, overflow hidden, no page scroll, all primary actions and evidence visible without scrolling
grid.shell: grid-template-columns: 200px minmax(0,1fr) 340px; grid-template-rows: 52px minmax(0,1fr) 60px; header spans all columns, step rail spans rows 2-3, factory stage center, evidence inspector right, decision bar bottom center+right
grid.stageRatio: Factory SVG receives at least 55% of viewport width and 62% of viewport height; guide becomes one 56px instruction strip above the stage, not a stacked card
grid.density: 12px shell padding, 8px panel gaps, 16px panel padding; internal evidence overflow:auto only inside the right inspector if content exceeds available height

colorTokens.accent-action: #c6ed8d primary actions, active step, affected-state highlights
colorTokens.silver-border: rgba(197,204,212,0.22) 1px dividers and SVG idle equipment
colorTokens.logo-emerald: Reserved exclusively to the supplied immutable logo asset; never recolor, redraw, outline, or sample it as a substitute UI accent
colorTokens.hold-state: #c6ed8d outline plus diagonal hatch pattern, never color alone
colorTokens.blocked-state: #c5ccd4 dashed route with blocked marker, never color alone

typography.family: System sans stack only, no external font dependency for offline use
typography.scale: Stage title 26px/32px 700, panel title 16px/22px 650, body 13px/19px, micro-label 11px/14px 700 uppercase 0.08em letter-spacing, metrics 28px/30px tabular-nums
typography.heroRule: No 48px+ hero headline inside the working surface; incident name is the stage title and status is one sentence maximum
typography.narrationRule: One current instruction, one status line, one primary verb per screen; delete repeated notice, recap, and mission copy
typography.numbers: Impact metrics use tabular figures and stay attached to the factory nodes or evidence they describe

motion.default: 160-220ms ease-out on opacity and transform only for panel entry, route highlighting, and state change; no parallax, no continuous decorative loops
motion.factory: State-driven SVG transitions only: 240ms route trace when a path becomes feasible or blocked, single pulse on newly held equipment, then static
motion.reducedMotion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): transition none, animation none, SVG dash/pulse/flow effects disabled, state shown with static hatch, icons, labels, and instant route changes
motion.focusMotion: Focus indicator appears instantly and is never animated

components.Header: 52px, immutable logo at native aspect ratio on #050705 at left, Forgefront Systems and FACTORY RESILIENCE center-left, recovery state and HUMAN DECISION badge right; no separate operator notice row
components.StepRail: 200px vertical rail rendering every supplied guided step from state, not a shortened hard-coded list; each item is a real <button> or <a>, 40px high, numbered, completed/current/locked states shown by icon plus label plus color
components.GuideStrip: Single 56px strip above stage: step count derived from the guided-steps array, current verb-led instruction, elapsed state if supplied by state, and one primary action at right; Lock recovery room moves to header as an icon button with text label
components.FactoryStage: Full-bleed cinematic SVG command surface with title, status chip, legend, and zoom-independent labels; keyboard-focusable nodes expose the same facts as the evidence inspector
components.EvidenceInspector: 340px right panel: certificate versus receiving comparison, discrepancy callout, impacted jobs, held-demand units, feasible-path count; Inspect source evidence is the primary button, expanded by default on Step 1
components.DecisionBar: 60px bottom bar with back action left, current required action center, primary next action right; destructive or locking actions separated and labelled in text
components.KeyboardAccess: Visible skip-to-stage link, logical tab order header > step rail > guide action > factory nodes > evidence > decision bar, 2px #c6ed8d focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element, Left/Right or Up/Down moves between steps and factory nodes, Enter/Space activates, Esc closes any drawer, aria-current=step on the active step, aria-live=polite limited to state changes only

visualizations.FactorySVG: Cinematic inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 960 560, layered as receiving dock > material hold/QA gate > production line > two impacted production orders; equipment drawn in brushed-silver strokes on black, held segment in #c6ed8d with hatch fill and HELD label, blocked route dashed silver with a blocked marker
visualizations.StateBinding: Every SVG node, route, badge, and count binds to real supplied state: certificate discrepancy holds incoming material, 2 impacted jobs, 70 held-demand units, 3 feasible paths shown only as labelled route options when that state is active; no decorative machines, flows, percentages, or outcomes unrelated to state
visualizations.EvidenceComparison: Two aligned horizontal quantity tracks labelled Certificate and Receiving with an explicit DOES NOT MATCH marker spanning the gap; do not invent quantities beyond the supplied snapshot, show values only when present in state
visualizations.ImpactOverlay: Selecting or tabbing to an impacted job in the SVG highlights its route and the matching evidence row simultaneously; selecting the held lot highlights dock, QA gate, and stopped line segment
visualizations.Legend: Persistent 24px legend under the stage: Running, Held, Blocked, Feasible path, each distinguished by line pattern and label as well as color

fixes.change: Fit 1366x768 with zero page scroll: remove the stacked header notice, oversized guide card, recap banner, and hero panel; replace with 52px header, 56px guide strip, center factory stage, 340px evidence inspector, and 60px decision bar inside a 100dvh shell

Add the missing cinematic factory SVG as the dominant center surface: receiving dock, material hold/QA gate, stopped production line, and the 2 impacted production orders, all driven by the certificate-discrepancy state; remove the empty concentric-arc hero decoration

Reconcile step counts from one state source: screen says Step 1 of 7, sidebar shows 5 items, supplied guided steps list 8; render the count and rail labels from the same guided-steps array and mark Step 1 with aria-current=step

Bring the actual task into the first viewport: make Inspect source evidence the primary button in the decision bar and open the certificate-versus-receiving evidence in the right inspector by default instead of a collapsed disclosure below the fold

Cut narration to one instruction: keep 'Open the certificate and receiving evidence' and delete the fresh-scenario notice, recovery-mission recap, hero paragraphs, and repeated discrepancy copy from the working surface

Replace the vague Show next action button with the verb-led current action and move Lock recovery room to the header as a labelled button; never stack a primary action above an unstyled text action in the guide
Attach the 2 impacted jobs, 70 held-demand units, and 3 feasible paths to their SVG nodes and evidence rows as compact state chips instead of three detached oversized numbers below a text box

Implement full keyboard access: step rail items and factory nodes are focusable controls with 2px #c6ed8d focus outline, arrow-key movement, Enter/Space activation, Esc to close drawers, and a skip-to-stage link as the first tab stop

Reduce the hero type from display scale to a 26px stage title 'Certificate discrepancy' with a single status line 'A line on hold' as a chip; preserve the immutable black, emerald/neon green, and brushed silver logo exactly as supplied, unrecolored and uncropped

Honour reduced motion: SVG hold pulse and route tracing run once at 240ms maximum, and under prefers-reduced-motion all pulse, dash, and flow animation is removed in favour of static hatch, dashed blocked routes, and text labels
